Bianca: Am I a little late again?
So-oooo-orry!{VAR BE01}

Bianca: I know. Sorry, {VAR 0100 0000}.
Sorry, Cheren.{VAR BE01}
Cheren: Naturally.{VAR BE01}

Cheren: Aren't you going to check
out the gift box? Where are you going?{VAR BE01}

Cheren: Would you get a move on
and open the gift box already?{VAR BE01}
I'm sure the Pokémon are just as
excited to meet us!

Bianca: Ooh!
What kind of Pokémon could they be?
{VAR 0100 0000} opened the gift box!{VAR BE01}

entries.text:
I've brought three Pokémon,
one for you and one for each
of your friends. Please settle
your choices politely.
Enjoy your Pokémon!
                --Professor Juniper
Is this the Pokémon you want?
